description: Extracts all videos from a YouTube playlist using apidojo's YouTube Playlist Scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: get all videos from a YouTube playlist, scrape a YouTube playlist for video data, export playlist video metadata, fetch video stats from a YouTube playlist URL, collect all videos in a YouTube channel playlist, download YouTube playlist contents, or analyze a curated list of YouTube videos. Returns video title, URL, view count, like count, duration, channel info, and description per video. Ideal for content curators, educators, and YouTube channel analysts.
